statements.markdown: **Theorem 6.91 (The signed endpoint recurrence).** *The signed next-step expression is $H(D,k,n)=2S(D,k,n-1)+1-c_D(n)$. The last term counts the selected exponents dividing the new endpoint. This is the same recurrence shape as the generic tempered-orbit recurrence $u(N+1)=2u(N)-v\cdot c(N+1)$ from the tempered-orbit criterion (Theorem [6.105](#record:257bm-i-t7) below), specialised to Mersenne local repair. A matching recurrence alone does not imply rationality: Theorem [6.105](#record:257bm-i-t7) also requires one fixed coefficient sequence, integer states and a vanishing scaled limit. Those additional conditions must be checked before that criterion can be applied to these finite-row quantities.*
